selected_evidence.requirement: Configure `/srv/drop` as shared writable with cross-owner deletion protection
selected_evidence.summary: Stat reported mode 1777; an unprivileged identity created a file, while deletion of a root-owned file failed with Operation not permitted.

Captured pre-restart boot ID and healthy state, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed a changed boot ID, then confirmed system health, mode 1777, matching persisted file hashes, writable access, and sticky-bit protection.

commands.command: id; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; if [ -e /srv/drop ]; then stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/drop; else printf 'path=/srv/drop state=absent\n'; fi
install -d -o root -g root -m 1777 /srv/drop && stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/drop

printf 'persistence-marker-node1
' > /srv/drop/root-owned-proof && chmod 0644 /srv/drop/root-owned-proof && setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups sh -c "printf 'unprivileged-write-proof
' > /srv/drop/user-owned-proof" && stat -c 'file=%n uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a' /srv/drop/root-owned-proof /srv/drop/user-owned-proof && if setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups rm /srv/drop/root-owned-proof 2>/tmp/drop-rm-error; then printf 'ERROR: cross-owner deletion unexpectedly succeeded
'; exit 1; else printf 'cross_owner_delete=blocked
'; sed -n '1p' /tmp/drop-rm-error; fi && test -f /srv/drop/root-owned-proof && printf 'root_owned_file=present
' && sha256sum /srv/drop/root-owned-proof /srv/drop/user-owned-proof
